movement: A.3 strictly extends the review06 principal-surface formula to every odd-degree polarization on every characteristic-two abelian surface; the completed ordinary argument further allows arbitrary polarization degree. Exact all-degree ranks are also proved for the fixed supersingular product with exactly one even factor of2-adic valuation1, and for both-even product factors. All complete proofs and the independent rectangular matrix reconstruction passed. These are structural infinite-family extensions; arbitrary-X ranks remain open.

The previously explicit unresolved E.2 refinement with BOTH locally Noetherian base and coherent coefficients is now closed. For flat locally finitely presented X/S, ordinary coherent stratifications and quasi-coherent infinitesimal crystals with coherent value onX are equivalent on either site, including arbitrary classical tests and every characteristic. Three full independent proof/source audits passed. The broad E.2 counterexamples are unchanged.

B.4 is strictly reduced from review06's least-index set{2,3,4} to{2,3}: the completed logarithm theorem excludes every81-torsion ambiguity. Every remaining27-torsion pair is now realized elliptically, with the exact tame character t=4/gcd(4,vDelta). The residual question is the stated six-coefficient comparison over the ramification-two Witt DVR, with discriminant bound23. Its existence has not been decided.
unresolved_refinements: General A.3 structural ranks and A.4 structural monodromy remain open. Ordinary arbitrary-embedding degreesn>=3 are a separate post-freeze candidate and are not counted in this review.

The supersingular local collision lemmas and one global mixed contact witness are proved. The two further tangent-triple witness files have complete certificates and independent checks but remain outside the frozen paper; the full collision-reduction proof and uniform higher-degree propagation are not counted as completed here.

Higher-dimensional sharp torsion thresholds in B.3, the residual27 ambiguity in B.4 and the general least character index remain open. Packaging, source access, notation repairs and repeated certificate runs are not counted as progress.
